# Do your package.json, .nvmrc, Dockerfile and CI agree on which Node.js to run?

> Paste package.json, .nvmrc, .tool-versions, a Dockerfile and a GitHub Actions workflow and see whether your Node.js versions drifted: a pin that breaks engines.node, majors that disagree across files, end-of-life Node.js, or an unbounded engines range. Free, deterministic, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
